name: model-routing
how_to_use: Cheap, high-frequency decision: ~one forward pass instead of an LLM call per message.

question.instructions: Does a good answer need multi-step reasoning, a derivation, a code design, or comparing several concepts?

criteria.true: a correct answer requires several reasoning steps, a derivation, code, or a comparison
criteria.false: a short definition, recall or single-concept explanation is enough

state_shape: see P.build_state(...) - only the user's/student's own words
wiring:
from backend.app.decider import patterns as P
from backend.app.decider.client import get_client
from backend.app.decider.calibration import get_thresholds

thr = get_thresholds()
decisions, ask = P.run_patterns(get_client(), state, [P.complexity_router()], thr.get)   # ONE round trip for all patterns
d = decisions["complexity"]
if d.triggered:          # plain Python owns the control flow
    ...                  # use the deep model tier; otherwise the fast tier
note: Cheap, high-frequency decision: ~one forward pass instead of an LLM call per message.
